description: This file contains function definitions and dispatch setup for various affine quantization and dequantization operations on tensors within the ATen library of PyTorch. It provides mechanisms for per-tensor and per-channel quantization, including checks and stub dispatch calls.

methods.name: void checkRoundingMode(const char * fn_name)
methods.description: Checks or manages the rounding mode, currently disabled with comments.

methods.name: void checkFloatTensor(const char * fn_name,const Tensor & t)
methods.description: Verifies that the tensor is of float type.

methods.name: void checkSameDevice(const char * fn_name,const Tensor & t1,const Tensor & t2)
methods.description: Ensures two tensors are on the same device.

methods.name: void checkQuantizedTensor(const char * fn_name,const Tensor & t)
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is quantized and of expected type.

methods.name: void checkZeroPoint(const char * fn_name,int64_t zero_point)
methods.description: Verifies zero point within valid range for type T.

methods.name: void checkZeroPoints(const char * fn_name,const Tensor & zero_points)
methods.description: Checks each zero point in a zero_points tensor.

methods.name: void checkSameSize(const char * fn_name,const Tensor & qt,const Tensor & rt)
methods.description: Ensures tensors have the same shape.

methods.name: void checkPerChannelParamsSize(const Tensor & rtensor,int64_t axis,const Tensor & scales,const Tensor & zero_points)
methods.description: Checks if scales and zero points tensors match expected size based on the channel dimension.

methods.name: Tensor & quantize_tensor_per_tensor_affine(const Tensor & rtensor,Tensor & qtensor,double scale,int64_t zero_point)
methods.description: Quantizes a float tensor into a quantized tensor using per-tensor affine parameters.

methods.name: Tensor & quantize_tensor_per_channel_affine(const Tensor & rtensor,Tensor & qtensor,const Tensor & scales,Tensor zero_points,int64_t axis)
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor into a quantized tensor using per-channel affine parameters.

methods.name: Tensor & quantize_tensor_per_channel_float_qparams(const Tensor & rtensor,Tensor & qtensor,const Tensor & scales,const Tensor & zero_points,int64_t axis)
methods.description: Quantizes a tensor with per-channel floating point scale and zero points.

methods.name: Tensor & dequantize_tensor_per_tensor_affine(const Tensor & qtensor,Tensor & rtensor,double scale,int64_t zero_point)
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor back to float using per-tensor affine parameters.

methods.name: Tensor & dequantize_tensor_per_channel_affine(const Tensor & qtensor,Tensor & rtensor,const Tensor & scales,Tensor zero_points,int64_t axis)
methods.description: Dequantizes a quantized tensor back to float using per-channel affine parameters.

methods.name: Tensor & dequantize_tensor_per_channel_float_qparams(const Tensor & qtensor,Tensor & rtensor,const Tensor & scales,const Tensor & zero_points,int64_t axis)
methods.description: Dequantizes a tensor using per-channel floating point scale and zero points.
